Lie down prone
True Crawling
Lie down / get up speed
Multiplies the speed of the lie-down and get-up animations. 1 = original (about 2 seconds), 2 = twice as fast.
Both legs broken = forced to crawl
With both legs fractured you drop prone and cannot stand up until they heal.
Enable the prone stance
Disabled: no more lying down or crawling.
Land standing after a fall
Prone on a roof and you fall off: you land the vanilla way (standing, or knocked down if hurt) instead of staying prone.
Fast crawl (run key)
Speed multiplier when running while prone. Costs more stamina.
Hiding spots under vehicles and beds
Zombie memory when you hide (seconds)
Zombies that were chasing you when you crawled under a vehicle or a bed keep coming and gather around it for this long. 0 = they forget you at once.
Lying under a vehicle or a bed, zombies lose you and cannot attack you anymore.
Aim kneeling when crouched
Crouched with a firearm, aiming puts one knee on the ground (poses built from the game's own kneeling and aiming animations). Off: the game's crouched aim.
Crawl speed
Multiplies the prone movement speed. 1 = the original animation.
A splint lets you stand up
Enabled: a splinted leg no longer counts as broken. Disabled: crawl until the fracture heals.
Stamina cost
Multiplies crawling fatigue. 2 = twice as hard, 0.5 = half.
No room to get up here.
My legs... I can't stand up.
Too tired to spring up.
Hold the crouch key to lie down

A short press crouches as usual; holding the crouch key for half a second goes prone (or gets up). Prone, a short press gets you up crouched; with the run key (Shift) held, you spring up fast at a heavy stamina cost.
Lie down / get up
Key to go prone or to stand back up.
